When they persisted in their evil and increased their mockery of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, God Almighty revealed: “So proclaim what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists. Indeed, We will suffice you against the mockers, who set up with God another deity. They are going to know.” Ibn Ishaq said: Yazid bin Ruman told me on the authority of Urwah bin Az-Zubayr or another scholar that Gabriel came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, while he was circumambulating the House. He stood up and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, stood beside him. Al-Aswad bin Abd Yaghuth passed by him and pointed to his stomach, so he asked for water from his stomach. Al-Walid bin Al-Mughira passed by him and pointed to a wound at the bottom of his heel, which had occurred to him two years before, while he was cutting his garment. He passed by a man from Khuza’ah who was feathering his arrows, and one of his arrows got stuck in his garment and scratched his foot, which was nothing, so he shook it off and killed him. Al-Aas bin Wa’il passed by him and pointed to the sole of his foot, so he went out on his donkey heading to Taif, and it lay down on a thorn and it entered the sole of his foot and killed him. Al-Harith bin At-Talalatah passed by him and pointed to his head, so he blew pus and killed him. Muhammad ibn Ishaq said: Muhammad ibn Abi Muhammad told me on the authority of a man, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: Their leader was Al-Walid ibn Al-Mughira, and he was the one who gathered them. And this is how it was narrated on the authority of Saeed ibn Jubayr and Ikrimah, similar to the context of Muhammad ibn Ishaq, on the authority of Yazid, on the authority of Urwah, in full, except that Saeed says: Al-Harith ibn Ghaytila, and Ikrimah says: Al-Harith ibn Qays. Al-Zuhri said: And he is truthful, he is Al-Harith ibn Qays, and his mother is Ghaytila. And this is how it was narrated on the authority of Mujahid, Muqsim, Qatadah, and more than one, that they were five. Al-Sha’bi said: They were seven, and the first is the well-known view: And His statement: Those who set up with God another god - they are going to know is a severe threat and a definite warning to whoever sets up another god with God. And His statement: “And We certainly know that your breast is constrained by what they say. So exalt the praises of your Lord and be among those who prostrate.” That is, We know, O Muhammad, that because of their harm to you, you feel constricted and distressed, but that does not make you weak or prevent you from conveying the message of God. Put your trust in Him, for He is sufficient for you and your supporter against them. So occupy yourself with the remembrance of God, praising Him, glorifying Him, and worshipping Him, which is prayer. For this reason, He said: So exalt the praises of your Lord and be among those who prostrate. As came in the hadith narrated by Imam Ahmad: Abd al-Rahman ibn Mahdi told us, Muawiyah ibn Salih told us, on the authority of Abu al-Zahriyyah, on the authority of Katheer ibn Murrah, on the authority of Nu’aym ibn Hammar, that he heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say: God Almighty said, O son of Adam, do not be unable to perform four rak’ahs at the beginning of the day, and I will suffice you at the end of it. Abu Dawud and al-Nasa’i narrated it from the hadith of Makhul, on the authority of Katheer ibn Murrah, in a similar manner. For this reason, whenever the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was distressed by something, he would pray. And his saying: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty. Al-Bukhari said: Salim said: Death. This Salim is Salim bin Abdullah bin Omar, as Ibn Jarir said: Muhammad bin Bashar told us, Yahya bin Saeed told us on the authority of Sufyan, Tariq bin Abdul Rahman told me on the authority of Salim bin Abdullah: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty. He said: Death. And this is what Mujahid, Al-Hasan, Qatadah, Abdul Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam and others said. The evidence for that is the saying of God Almighty, informing about the people of Hell that they said: We were not of those who prayed, nor did we feed the poor, and we engaged in vain talk with those who engaged in vain talk, and we denied the Day of Judgment, until there came to us the certainty. And in the Sahih from the hadith of Al-Zuhri on the authority of Kharijah bin Zaid bin Thabit, on the authority of Umm Al-Ala, a woman from the Ansar, that when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, entered upon Uthman bin Maz’un and he had died, Umm Al-Ala said: May God have mercy on you, Abu Al-Sa’ib, for my testimony is that God has honored you. So the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: And how do you know that God has honored him? I said: May my father and mother be sacrificed for you, O Messenger of God, who? He said: As for him, certainty has come to him, and I hope good for him. This noble verse is used as evidence, which is His statement: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty, that worship, such as prayer and the like, is obligatory upon a person as long as his mind is sound, so he prays according to his condition. It was also proven in Sahih Al-Bukhari on the authority of Imran bin Husayn, may God be pleased with them both, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Pray standing, and if you are unable to, then sitting, and if you are unable to, then on your side. This is used as evidence to prove the error of those atheists who believe that what is meant by certainty is knowledge. When one of them attains knowledge, he is no longer obligated, according to them. This is disbelief, misguidance, and ignorance, because the prophets, peace be upon them, and their companions were the most knowledgeable of God and the most aware of His rights and attributes, and what He deserves in terms of glorification. They were also the most devout and the most devoted to doing good deeds until death. What is meant by certainty here is death, as we have already mentioned. Praise and thanks be to God, and praise be to God for guidance, and upon Him we must seek help and trust. He is the One who is asked to cause us to die in the most perfect and best of conditions, for He is Generous and Noble. The last interpretation of Surat Al-Hijr, and praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds.

Mujahid said: It is reciting the Qur'an aloud in prayer.
